title: C-ArmLSpine demo sweeps
summary: Two recorded C-arm sweeps of C-ArmLSpine, case134 and case39: test persons no run trains on.
does: The raw CBCT projections of two C-ArmLSpine cases, played as fluoroscopy sweeps: clips of grey frames with truth boxes. Both persons are frozen test persons (data/splits/test-persons.json), so a sweep is only read at the end, never trained on. The latency word's sweep part runs one through the frame path with its overlay (tools/sweep.py); today it passes case134. Frames per sweep are not recorded in the repository.
